Sam (Support): Escalating: Atlan trial tenant atlan-trial-21 failing seat activations. 502s on /v1/provision and bursts of 429s. Customers can't finish onboarding.
Rina (CS Lead): Acknowledged. Any quick mitigation?
Sam (Support): Key rotation + retry gave a few successes but not stable. Logs show provisioner backlog. Tagging SEs.
Kai (Solutions Eng): We can reroute provisioning to a fallback pool as a short-term unblock. Internal command: curl -X POST /internal/reroute -d '{"tenant":"atlan-trial-21","pool":"fallback-provision","expires_in":7200}'
Jules (CSM): Please proceed. This account shows expansion signals; want a customer touch ASAP. Ill draft a 10m ack and propose a 30m sync.
inc-bot: Incident INC-2025-2248 created (P2) - runbook: internal/playbooks/provisioning-backlog.md
Sam (Support): Reroute applied, API returned 200. Monitoring now, provision success rate improving.
Kai (Solutions Eng): Adding auto-expiry and watching KV/quota.
Jules (CSM): Invite sent for +25m; customer replied: "Thanks, can add first user." Pasting ack to private notes.
Rina (CS Lead): Assigning owners: Jules = comms + customer call, Sam = reroute & monitor, Kai = SE monitoring, I'll own postmortem. Keep updates short here.
Sam (Support): Monitoring stable; will close once infra confirms full fix.
Rina (CS Lead): Good work team. After postmortem, add a short onboarding FAQ about the reroute mitigation and when to offer credits.
